scope.article: Full extracted body, all 15 figures inspected; figure 5/10/11 labels enlarged. No independent experiments.
scope.dreams: Lifecycle, input/output, access, cancellation, archiving, usage, limits and errors prose; representative cURL examples; not every SDK variant.
scope.managed-memory: Storage/access, concurrent updates, versioning, recovery, retention and limits prose; representative examples, not every SDK variant.
scope.code-memory: CLAUDE.md versus auto memory, loaded context, auto-memory storage/limits and troubleshooting; not a complete audit of all instruction-file settings.
scope.self-hosted-memory: Full page prose and Python example, including sync, conflicts, read-only limits and crash cleanup; commands not run.
scope.memory-tool: Architecture/handler ownership, commands, security and retention sections; not every SDK implementation example.
scope.dynamic-dreaming: Workflow overview, analyzer/organizer prompts, adoption, nightly selection/retry/retention and limitations; displayed code loses indentation, no runtime or helper-module audit.
scope.cl-bench: Title/byline only; substantive benchmark body not recovered. Article results are not independently verified.
scope.sleep: Full blog text; external-memory versus model-weight mechanism contrast only; papers/benchmarks not independently reviewed.

limits: No model/API sessions, dreams, training or experiments run. No live memory or policies changed.
Article figures are author-reported; neurological analogy is not mechanistic validation.
CL-Bench linked release extraction is title-only.
Neuroscience papers, sleep-time compute paper, Harvey benchmark repo, Pokemon video and Duet product page not reviewed; not claimed as independent support.
Cookbook readable code loses indentation; original HTML retained. SDK language variants not exhaustively read.
Knowledge-wiki README pinned; this is not a full source checkout or runtime audit.
